spaceship_titanic.title: Spaceship Titanic
spaceship_titanic.description: Predict whether each passenger was transported to another dimension, using passenger records. This is binary classification. Predict True or False for every original test passenger.

columns.PassengerId: Passenger key gggg_pp; shared gggg denotes a travel group.
columns.CryoSleep: Whether the passenger chose suspended animation and remained in their cabin.
columns.Cabin: Cabin location as deck/number/side; side is P or S.
columns.VIP: Whether the passenger paid for VIP service.
columns.VRDeck: Amount billed for virtual reality services.
columns.Name: Passenger first and last names.
columns.Transported: Boolean target: whether the passenger was transported.
